sentences.text: Britney Jean Spears -LRB- born December 2 , 1981 -RRB- is an American singer , dancer , and actress .	Britney	Britney (album)	Britney Jean	Britney Jean

Born in McComb , Mississippi , and raised in Kentwood , Louisiana , she performed acting roles in stage productions and television shows as a child before signing with Jive Records in 1997 .	Jive	Jive Records	Jive Records	Jive Records
Spears 's first and second studio albums , ... Baby One More Time -LRB- 1999 -RRB- and Oops !
... I Did It Again -LRB- 2000 -RRB- , became international successes , with the former becoming the best-selling album by a teenage solo artist .
Title tracks '' ... Baby One More Time '' and `` Oops !
... I Did It Again '' broke international sales records .

In 2001 , Spears released her self-titled third studio album , Britney , and played the starring role in the film Crossroads -LRB- 2002 -RRB- .	Britney	Britney (album)	Crossroads	Crossroads (2002 film)
She assumed creative control of her fourth studio album , In the Zone -LRB- 2003 -RRB- , which yielded the worldwide success of the single `` Toxic '' .	In the Zone	In the Zone	Toxic	Toxic (song)
In 2007 , Spears 's much-publicized personal issues sent her career into hiatus .

Her fifth studio album , Blackout , was released later that year , and spawned singles such as `` Gim me More '' and `` Piece of Me '' .	Blackout	Blackout (Britney Spears album)	Piece of Me	Piece of Me
Her erratic behavior and hospitalizations continued through the following year , at which point she was placed under a still ongoing conservatorship .	conservatorship	conservatorship
Spears 's sixth studio album , Circus -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , included the international chart-topping single `` Womanizer '' .	Circus	Circus (Britney Spears album)	Womanizer	Womanizer (song)
Her seventh studio album , Femme Fatale -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , became her first to yield three top-ten singles in the United States .	Femme Fatale	Femme Fatale (Britney Spears album)
She released her eighth studio album Britney Jean in 2013 .	Britney	Britney (album)	Britney Jean	Britney Jean

Later that year , Spears began the four-year residency show , Britney : Piece of Me , at The AXIS at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino in Las Vegas . In 2016 , Spears released her ninth studio album , Glory .	Glory	Glory (Britney Spears album)
In 2017 , she announced that her residency show would develop into a world tour , Britney : Live in Concert .	Britney	Britney (album)	residency show	residency show
Spears is regarded as a pop icon and credited with influencing the revival of teen pop during the late 1990s .	pop icon	pop icon	teen pop	teen pop
She became the best-selling teenage artist of all time and garnered honorific titles including the `` Princess of Pop '' .	Pop	Pop music	Princess of Pop	Honorific nicknames in popular music

Her work has earned her numerous awards and accolades , including a Grammy Award , six MTV Video Music Awards including the Lifetime Achievement Award , seven Billboard Music Awards including the Millennium Award and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame .	numerous awards	List of awards and nominations received by Britney Spears	Grammy Award	Grammy Awards	MTV Video Music Awards	MTV Video Music Awards	Lifetime Achievement Award	Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award	Hollywood Walk of Fame	Hollywood Walk of Fame
In 2009 , Billboard ranked her as the 8th overall Artist of the Decade , and also recognized her as the best-selling female artist of the 2000s , as well as the fifth overall .

The Recording Industry Association of America -LRB- RIAA -RRB- lists Spears as the eighth top-selling female artist in the United States , with 34 million certified albums . According to Billboard Spears has sold about 22.38 million singles in digital downloads in US and is the fourth best-selling female artist since Nielsen SoundScan began .

Rolling Stone recognized her instant success as one of the Top 25 Teen Idol Breakout Moments of all time , while VH1 ranked her eleventh on their `` 100 Greatest Women in Music '' list in 2012 , and Billboard named her the sexiest woman in music .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	VH1	VH1
